en: A colorized historic postcard view of a Central European spa or resort town set in a forested valley. In the foreground are several ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villas and hotels with mansard roofs and decorative façades. Behind them, scattered on the green hillside, stand more villas and a large, castle‑like white building at the top of the slope. Dense coniferous forest covers the surrounding hills under a blue sky. One prominent white building in the lower right bears the name 'VILLA GRENZ' on its façade.
